resource_risks.description: The overview command now writes a manifest file under app data.
resource_risks.mitigation: The manifest is written once per refresh through write_pretty_json, which creates the parent directory and closes the file handle immediately.

resource_risks.description: Refreshing the manifest could still scan too many files as accumulated stores grow.
resource_risks.mitigation: Existing scan cap remains MAX_ACCUMULATED_DATA_SCAN_FILES per store, and the manifest stores summaries rather than raw content.

lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: No watcher, daemon, persistent connection, or open stream is created.

measurement_checks.threshold: summary metadata only; no stdout/stderr contents

notes: No dependency install, database migration, long-running process, or global filesystem change was added.
